profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend & Distributed Systems | Java · Spring Boot · Docker · Kubernetes | Video Streaming & Networking
profile.summary: Backend engineer with ~10 years of experience building reliable systems across telecom, networking, video streaming, and cybersecurity. Nearly six years at Resi Media building distributed live-video streaming software — Java Spring Boot services and REST APIs around high-performance encoding pipelines on Linux-based hardware, deployed with Docker and Kubernetes. Previously at Cisco and Tellabs; now at Forescout. B.S. Computer Engineering, Texas A&M.
